CAC CURVE DATA: Jan $127K@$65 blended. By daily spend: $2-4K=$57 CAC, $4-5K=$76, $5-6K=$77, $6K+=$93. Formula: CAC = $55 + (MonthlySpend - $100K) x 0.00038. At $150K=$74 CAC (90d payback). At $226K=$100 CAC (Al's target). At $300K=$115 CAC (120d payback).

WORKING CAPITAL MODEL: WC is about DELTA when scaling, not total. Current $150K cycling fine. To scale: $175K needs $65K more WC. $200K needs $150K more. $226K needs $230K more. $300K needs $450K more. Rule: Higher spend = higher CAC = longer payback = more WC float needed. Message to Finance: $150K to $300K requires ~$450K additional WC due to CAC rising from $60 to $115.
